audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 all read 'Skill' while the whys under them say 'Illaoi dominates level 1', 'your tentacle field out-sustains his passive' and 'Level 6 still yours'. 2+ items read Illaoi while whys[6], spikes[3] and late all say K'Sante becomes an unkillable resetting duelist.
audit.why: Packet chart is Illaoi for six stages then K'Sante; 54.81% over 1155 games is a lane Illaoi wins early and loses to scaling.
audit.corrected: Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 -> Illaoi; 2+ items -> K'Sante; both layers, ratings moved. diffRating 6/10 -> 5/10 to match a favoured lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.sequencingCues is 0 — All Out was only 'his duelist mode' with no cooldown, and no ability had a number attached.
audit.why: All Out is 120/100/80s and heals him; Ntofo Strikes is a flat 3.5s and fires its pull on the second stack; Path Maker is 14/13/12/11/10s; Footwork is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Your Test of Spirit is 16s at rank 1, so his short cooldowns come back between your commits.
audit.corrected: All Out's 120s and the anti-heal timing written into the do's; Ntofo Strikes' 3.5s and two-stack pull into the don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions absent: Dauntless Instinct marking targets so his damage lands on the following auto; Path Maker dealing true damage while he takes reduced damage charging it; All Out's healing being the actual reason to buy Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Riot's text: his abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next attack, so the ability cast is the warning and the auto is the hit. Path Maker carries the trueDamage flag and Riot's text has him taking reduced damage during the charge — attacking into it is the worst moment to trade, and armour does not reduce the payoff. All Out's text grants healing at the cost of reduced defenses.
audit.corrected: Mark-then-auto and the All Out heal written into key interactions; Path Maker's true damage and damage-reduced charge into the don'ts; anti-heal tied to All Out in itemization.

edits.before: His duelist mode. While down, you out-grind. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: All Out is 120s at rank 1 and heals him — save your Grievous Wounds for it.

edits.before: That is K'Sante's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: His second Ntofo Strike fires the pull, and Q is only 3.5s — step out after the first.

edits.before: Fighting in open ground with no tentacles — Illaoi without her field is the weakest juggernaut in the game.
edits.after: Path Maker's damage is true and he takes reduced damage charging it — armour buys you nothing there.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. While down, you out-grind. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: His abilities mark you, so damage arrives on the next auto. All Out heals and drops his defences — bring anti-heal.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (the slow makes tentacles land), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling before 6 — All Out heals him through tentacles.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you track All Out and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 5/10. You own every stage to your first item; at 2+ items All Out resets flip the duel to him.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 6/10, K'Sante carry threat 7/10.
edits.after: Favoured early — difficulty 5/10, K'Sante carry threat 7/10.

notes: Chart rows proposed in matched full/content pairs. Note for a future K'Sante-side audit: Path Maker loses its knockback and stun while All Out is active (Riot's own text), so his hard CC is only available outside his ultimate — the mirror should say the same. Illaoi's R still carries the bogus 'grounding' flag; no grounding claim written.
